text.p: Investment company General Securities Investments Ltd said on Tuesday it expected 1997 to be a favourable year after it turned in a profit of Singapore $16.15 million in the year ended December 31, 1996.
It said in a statement with its 1996 financial results that the outlook for global economic growth was buoyant and inflationary pressures were firmly under control.
"Asian markets will benefit from this scenario as valuations are attractive in an international context," it said.
The group's portfolio was fully invested in Asia and well positioned to take advantage of these developments, it said.
The company suffered a loss of S$7.13 million in 1995.
